project_outcome.statement: Formal TCC identities are closed in dimensions 4, 5, 7, and 8 by the preserved certificate suites. No dimension-six TCC identity is proved; its present boundary-packet formulation is retired rather than refuted.

why_active_gate_matters.statement: Cycle 157 verified the ordinary Fourier normalization but found no defined map from 36 additive spectral coefficients to three ray-class logarithms or AFK cocycle values. Without that map, neither the existing numerical growth nor the conditional downstream algebra can establish dimension-six TCC.

progress_criterion.statement: Advance only with an independently derived, convention-pinned coefficient-to-cocycle/ray-logarithm interface that specifies finite-characteristic selection, nonlinear/logarithmic operation, branches, boundary subtraction, and identification with the AFK cocycle; then test the smallest falsifiable finite-frequency prototype before reopening boundary-packet estimates.

cold_start_handoff.deferred_work: Further raw or ordinary-gauge boundary-packet numerics, a BF_6=>MFC_6 implication, Paper III release preparation, and any claim that dimension-six TCC is false are deferred. Legacy cycles 1--161 remain immutable and legacy-unprotected; they are evidence, not current-format records.
